stem: These data could be used to support which conclusion?

options.label: A
options.text: Gulf Coast states had to rely on steamboats to transport goods.

options.label: B
options.text: States in the lower South had more land devoted to plantations.

options.label: C
options.text: Border states had to import needed raw materials.

options.label: D
options.text: States in the upper South were heavily industrialized.
